class.name: IfcReinforcingBarType
class.brief_description: Definition from IAI: A steel bar, usually with manufactured deformations in the surface, used in concrete and masonry construction to provide additional strength. HISTORY New entity in IFC Release 2x4 Material Use Definition : An associated material denotes the steel grade, preferrably by material classification. Geometry Use Definition : The IfcReinforcingBarType may define the shared geometric r
class.description: Only in IFC4 and IFC4X3_ADD2 files.

members.member: The predefined type is always BAR. A String, one of the enumeration's values, or null when unset. Only in IFC4 and IFC4X3_ADD2 files: in others it reads as null and can't be set.
The nominal diameter defining the cross-section size of the reinforcing bar. A float, or null when unset. Only in IFC4 and IFC4X3_ADD2 files: in others it reads as null and can't be set.
The effective cross-section area of the reinforcing bar. A float, or null when unset. Only in IFC4 and IFC4X3_ADD2 files: in others it reads as null and can't be set.

The total length of the reinforcing bar. The total length of bended bars are calculated according to local standards with corrections for the bends. A float, or null when unset. Only in IFC4 and IFC4X3_ADD2 files: in others it reads as null and can't be set.

Indicator for whether the bar surface is plain or textured. A String, one of the enumeration's values, or null when unset. Only in IFC4 and IFC4X3_ADD2 files: in others it reads as null and can't be set.
A String, or null when unset. Only in IFC4 and IFC4X3_ADD2 files: in others it reads as null and can't be set.
An Array of values (String, float, int or bool), or null when unset. Only in IFC4 and IFC4X3_ADD2 files: in others it reads as null and can't be set.
